name: @answra/desktop
description: Electron 桌面壳：main/preload/renderer 三进程，renderer 只做薄壳，业务 UI 在 @answra/ui。

scripts.dev:answer: pnpm build:electron -- --profile=answer && concurrently -k "vite --mode answer --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5180 --strictPort" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5180 && electron ."
scripts.dev:full: pnpm build:electron -- --profile=full && concurrently -k "vite --mode full --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5180 --strictPort" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5180 && electron ."
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.main.json && tsc -p tsconfig.preload.json && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json
scripts.dist:win: pnpm build:answer && pnpm audit:packaged -- --profile=answer && node ./scripts/write-electron-builder-config.mjs --profile=answer && electron-builder --config .release-audit/answer/electron-builder.json --win nsis
scripts.dist:win:full: pnpm vad:prepare && pnpm asr:prepare && pnpm build && pnpm audit:packaged -- --profile=full && node ./scripts/write-electron-builder-config.mjs --profile=full && electron-builder --config .release-audit/full/electron-builder.json --win nsis
scripts.dist:mac: pnpm build:answer && pnpm audit:packaged -- --profile=answer && node ./scripts/write-electron-builder-config.mjs --profile=answer && electron-builder --config .release-audit/answer/electron-builder.json --mac --arm64 --x64

extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Answra 需要使用麦克风录入面试语音，用于本地转录与实时回答建议。
extendInfo.NSScreenCaptureUsageDescription: Answra 需要读取屏幕内容以生成笔试截图回复与实时面试建议。
